changelog:
Instagram Downloader v2.2 introduces multiple robust modes for downloading Instagram media.

- Adds three operation modes: sessionid (recommended), Apify fallback, and interactive setup wizard.
- Avoids password sharing by supporting sessionid cookies and interactive browser-based setup.
- Clarifies that the standard username/password login mode is broken due to Instagram deprecating the endpoint.
- Supports full download of reels (MP4), photos (JPG), and all carousel images (multi-image JPG) from any profile you can access.
- Provides detailed credential resolution order and guided setup for session cookie retrieval.
- Updates documentation with architecture diagrams, prerequisites, usage instructions, and command-line options.
